source_caption:
One of the most charming romantic comedies of the ‘80s. Moonstruck follows Loretta, an Italian-American widow who finds herself falling for the younger brother of the man she’s agreed to marry. What follows is a funny, messy, and unexpectedly heartfelt story about love, family, second chances, and the unpredictability of falling for someone.

Cher is absolutely wonderful in the lead role, bringing so much warmth, wit, and vulnerability to Loretta. Nicolas Cage is equally memorable, and their chemistry gives the film so much of its charm. There’s something timeless about the way the film captures the excitement, confusion, and irrationality of being in love.

A true romantic comedy classic that deserves to be watched and appreciated for generations.

🎥: Moonstruck(1987)
Dir. Norman Jewison

source_details.synopsis: Moonstruck is a 1987 American romantic comedy film directed by Norman Jewison and written by John Patrick Shanley. It stars Cher as a widowed Italian American woman who falls in love with her fiancé's hot-tempered, estranged younger brother, played by Nicolas Cage. The supporting cast includes Vincent Gardenia, Olympia Dukakis, and Danny Aiello. Moonstruck had a limited theatrical release in the United States on December 18, 1987, followed by a wide release on January 15, 1988, by Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer.
